status.description: The status of this stack can be one of the following enumerations
status.name: StatusEnum

enum.name: READ_WRITE
enum.description: The stack is fully operational and supports both read and write operations.

enum.name: READ_ONLY
enum.description: The stack is in read-only mode; write operations are disabled.

enum.name: DOWN
enum.description: The stack is down and not available for use.

currentMessage.description: This message applies to the current state of the stack.

pendingMaintenanceMessage.description: This message is used to notify users of pending maintenance
